descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark X98 Tri-Mode Gasket-Mounted Wireless Mechanical Keyboard - 102 Keys Full-Size Edition with Arabic / English Keycaps

Experience the pinnacle of luxurious typing acoustics and seamless multi-device productivity with the magnificent Attack Shark X98 Full-Size Wireless Mechanical Keyboard. Available now at Turbo Computer, this highly versatile 102-key compact full-sized PC hardware workspace peripheral introduces an advanced upgraded Gasket-Mount structural layout utilization paired with 20 premium silicone sockets for an ultra-soft, flexible, and premium tactile keystroke bottom-out. Masterfully tailored for gamers, programmers, and office professionals across Egypt, this setup includes factory durable Arabic and English high-quality PBT keycaps for extended durability and dual typing utility. Offering full Tri-Mode wireless connectivity pipelines alongside a huge 4000mAh internal battery capacity, this mechanical unit handles heavy load duties flawlessly, covered by a local official 1-year warranty protect matrix.

The engineering focal point of the Attack Shark X98 centers on its world-class 5-layer internal sound-absorbing acoustic layout (incorporating PORON foam, a 10x IXPE switch pad, a PET noise-cancellation pad, an EPDM dampening pad, and a premium silicone bottom base structure) to completely isolate and eliminate empty case hollowness or pinging resonance. Equipped with factory pre-lubed linear Blueberry switches, it outputs a silky smooth, fast, and quiet actuation profile. The 1.2mm single-key slotted PCB board structure fully features 3-pin and 5-pin hot-swappable sockets for absolute modular freedom. Backed by south-facing 16.8-million color vibrant RGB LED modules, full anti-ghosting technology, and intuitive web cloud custom driver software for macros and key remapping, this Windows and Mac-compatible powerhouse redefines heavy-duty workspace peripheral standards.
